import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] nMod = readInts(sc);
        int n = nMod[0];
        int mod = nMod[1];

        int edgeSum = n * (n - 1) / 2;
        int[][][] dp = new int[n + 1][edgeSum + 1][n + 1];
        dp[1][0][1] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= edgeSum; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
                    int val = dp[i][j][k];
                    if (val == 0) continue;
                    if (j + i <= edgeSum && i + 1 <= n) {
                        dp[i + 1][j + i][i + 1] = (dp[i + 1][j + i][i + 1] + val) % mod;
                    }
                    for (int l = 0; l < i; l++) {
                        int newJ = j + i - 1 - l;
                        if (newJ <= edgeSum) {
                            dp[i + 1][newJ][k] = (dp[i + 1][newJ][k] + val) % mod;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int[][][] prefixSum = new int[n + 1][n + 1][edgeSum + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
                int total = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j <= edgeSum; j++) {
                    total = (total + dp[i][j][k]) % mod;
                    prefixSum[i][k][j] = total;
                }
            }
        }

        int[][][] cumulative = new int[n + 1][edgeSum + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= edgeSum; j++) {
                int total = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
                    total = (total + prefixSum[i][k][j]) % mod;
                    cumulative[i][j][k] = total;
                }
            }
        }

        int[] answers = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long answer = (long) i * answers[i - 1] % mod;
            for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= edgeSum; j++) {
                    if (dp[i][j][k] == 0) continue;
                    int val = dp[i][j][k];
                    int totalCumulative = cumulative[i][j - 1][n] - (k >= 0 ? cumulative[i][j - 1][k] : 0);
                    totalCumulative = ((totalCumulative % mod) + mod) % mod; // ensure non-negative
                    answer = (answer + (long) val * totalCumulative) % mod;
                }
            }
            answers[i] = (int) answer;
        }

        System.out.println(answers[n]);
        sc.close();
    }

    private static int[] readInts(Scanner sc) {
        String[] parts = sc.nextLine().trim().split("\\s+");
        int[] res = new int[parts.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            res[i] = Integer.parseInt(parts[i]);
        }
        return res;
    }
}
